description: Defines classes and functions related to oneDNN Graph tensor descriptions and engine/stream management for PyTorch's JIT fuser, including LlgaTensorDesc, Engine, Stream, and LlgaTensorImpl.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Represents a device engine for oneDNN, singleton pattern for CPU.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a computation stream on top of the engine, singleton pattern for CPU.

classes.name: LlgaTensorDesc
classes.description: Describes a tensor in oneDNN Graph, including size, strides, data type, and layout.

classes.name: LlgaTensorImpl
classes.description: Tensor implementation wrapper for oneDNN tensors, extends c10::TensorImpl.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the singleton CPU engine for oneDNN.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the singleton CPU stream for oneDNN.

methods.name: logical_tensor
methods.description: Constructs a logical tensor description based on current tensor properties.

methods.name: llga_to_aten_tensor
methods.description: Converts LlgaTensorImpl to a standard ATen tensor.

methods.name: empty_llga
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor with specified LlgaTensorDesc.

methods.name: llga_from_aten_tensor
methods.description: Creates a Llga tensor from an ATen tensor.
